category.title: Category
category.description: Optional listing category filter: sale, rental, vacation, or new_project.

subcategory.title: Subcategory
subcategory.description: Optional listing subcategory filter, such as apartamentos or casas.

maxPages.title: Max pages
maxPages.description: Max pages per category for incremental or scoped test runs. Full mode ignores this and crawls all discovered pages.

crawlDetails.title: Crawl details
crawlDetails.description: When false, crawl only listing result pages and leave details for a later detail-only run.

syncDataset.title: Sync dataset
syncDataset.description: When true, listing insert/update events written to Postgres are also pushed to the Crawlee dataset. The actor defaults to true for incremental runs and false for full/detail-only runs when this field is omitted.

jobName.title: Job name
jobName.description: Human-readable job label shown in actor outputs.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Free-form run metadata for dashboard/debug context.
